title: Ciao, I'm Valentina
metaDescription: Native Italian, twenty years in fashion training people around the world, now teaching Italian and Spanish to adults in Atlanta and online.
intro: I'm Italian and I live in Atlanta. I teach Italian and Spanish to adults, one to one and in small groups, in person and online.

sections.heading: Twenty years of teaching, before I called it that
sections.body:
I spent twenty years in Italian fashion. My job was to travel the world and train store teams, in many countries and many languages. That is where I learned how adults really learn: by doing, in real situations, with someone who is patient and makes it fun.

When I moved to Atlanta I started teaching the languages I love the same way. Today I teach at two private schools in the city and with my own students, in person and online.

sections.heading: How I teach
sections.body:
We talk from the first lesson. Grammar comes in when you need it. Every lesson is built around your reasons for learning: a trip, your family, your work, or simply the pleasure of it.

I suggest two hours a week. It is enough to make real progress and still fit around a busy life.

sections.heading: And when you go to Italy
sections.body: If you are planning a trip, I can help you build an itinerary with the places tourists miss, and prepare the Italian you will need there.
